summary: A 55-year-old man with a history of systolic heart failure, renal cell carcinoma, and chronic kidney disease presents post-laparoscopic left radical nephrectomy and lymph node dissection. He has mild dyspnea, mild pain, and laboratory findings indicating renal and hematological compromise.

differential.reasoning: Presenting dyspnea and renal dysfunction strongly suggest acute exacerbation of chronic systolic heart failure.
